units.name: Department of Analytics, Information Systems, and Supply Chain
units.evidence: 2026–2027 official catalog gives this full department name, parent college, mission and Supply Chain Management major. Its mission explicitly covers supply-chain knowledge and professional preparation.

decisions.reason: Imported subject is a major housed in the explicitly named department; do not invent a separate Supply Chain Management department.
